name: Planned HHS work
about: Scope a future evidence-backed task without authorizing execution
---

## Goal and phase

State the question/phase and link the relevant roadmap issue.

## Evidence and current uncertainty

Identify what is observed, inferred, verified or unknown.

## Bounded scope

List allowed inputs, providers, resources and output artifacts.

## Non-goals and safety boundaries

DISCOVER != MODIFY. PLAN != EXECUTE. State what must not run or change.

## Acceptance evidence and stop condition

Define positive/failure checks, redaction and cleanup. Creating this issue does not authorize implementation or system modification.
